editor.doc_title_label: Title (shown at the top of the braille)

editor.doc_title_hint_ukaaf: The title will appear in the running head from braille page 2.
editor.doc_title_placeholder_heading: No title of its own: the first heading is used, “{title}”
editor.generated_title: Document title. BANA puts the book's title at the top of the first braille page. Change it in the Title field above the text.
editor.generated_head: Running head and print page number. editor.generated_foot: Braille page number. Emboss numbers the braille pages itself, at the end of the last line of each page (BANA 1.10).
editor.generated_ukaaf_head: Page information line. Emboss puts the braille page number, and the print page number when that is turned on, on the first line of each page (UKAAF).
editor.generated_other: Emboss added this line as part of the braille layout. It has no print of its own.

braille_fmt.title: Braille formatting
braille_fmt.button_title: Braille layout for this paragraph, list or table (Ctrl/⌘+Alt+B)
braille_fmt.none: This block has no extra braille formatting options.
braille_fmt.hint_list: List: numbering and start for the caret's level, bullet symbols by level, columns.
braille_fmt.hint_heading: Heading: how it joins to the headings around it.
braille_fmt.hint_verse: Verse or numbered line: line-number note.
braille_fmt.hint_table: Table: subdivisions, citation, totals, subheadings, guide dots, repeated headings.
braille_fmt.hint_para: Paragraph: layout, line-number and font options.
braille_fmt.hint_footnote: Footnote: where the note mark goes, plus font and page-break options.
braille_fmt.hint_box: Box (sidebar): box lines and page break.
braille_fmt.hint_pagenum: Print page change: how the page number is written.
braille_fmt.bullet: Bullet symbol for the selected item(s)
braille_fmt.bullet_help: The symbol printed before the item. Applies to the item with the caret, or every item in the selection.
braille_fmt.enum_help: Applies to every item at this level in the same run (the caret's sub-list), in one step. Choosing a number style makes bullets there numbers.
braille_fmt.start_help: The first number or letter of this run: 3 gives 3, 4, 5 or c, d, e. Leave empty for 1.
braille_fmt.err_start: Start at must be a whole number from 1 to 9999.
braille_fmt.sym_help: The bullet symbol used at each level of the whole list, in print and in braille. Leave all three on Default to keep the plain dot everywhere in braille.
braille_fmt.columns_help: Print columns the list is set in. Leave empty or 1 for a normal list.
braille_fmt.not_connected: Do not join to the heading above
braille_fmt.not_connected_help: Keeps this heading separate instead of running it on from the previous one.
braille_fmt.accompanies_box_help: The heading belongs with the box that follows it.
braille_fmt.end_marker_before_help: UKAAF only: a colons indicator line closing the previous section before this level-1 heading (B004 Glossary; James, UK-6). Off by default (UK-1).
braille_fmt.speaker_gap: Three-cell gap after the speaker name
braille_fmt.speaker_gap_help: Off follows print: two cells when print leaves two spaces after the name (BANA 14.10.5a), one when punctuation or capitals already set it off.
braille_fmt.ln_note_text_help: Your own wording for the note that explains line numbers. Leave empty for the standard sentence.
braille_fmt.ln_note_off_help: Suppresses the automatic note at this line.
braille_fmt.enclose_prefix_help: Only this opening text is enclosed in the note indicators. Leave empty to enclose the whole note.
braille_fmt.xref_help: Formats this as a cross-reference to another place in the book.
braille_fmt.directions_continued: Directions continued from the previous paragraph
braille_fmt.directions_labelled: Directions with a letter or number label
braille_fmt.table_not_stairstep: The subdivision rows and heading below only take effect when the table format is Stairstep.
braille_fmt.sub_rows_help: Body row numbers, counting from 1, separated by commas, for example 3, 6. Leave empty for none.
braille_fmt.column_align_help: One line per column that should not simply follow print’s own alignment, as "2: right" (column numbers count from 1). Right and decimal both place-value-align the column, worked out from its own entries (BANA 11.6.1c/d); left keeps it flush left even where print aligned it. Leave a column out to follow print.
braille_fmt.err_rows: Subdivision rows must be whole numbers from 1 upwards, separated by commas.
braille_fmt.err_column_align: Column alignment override: write one per line as "column number: left", "column number: right" or "column number: decimal", with a column number that is in the table, each column once.
braille_fmt.err_columns: Columns must be a whole number from 1 to 9.
braille_fmt.err_csv: Separate the entries with commas, with nothing empty between the commas.
braille_fmt.err_arrow: Arrow lines: each line may hold at most 60 characters.
braille_fmt.err_citation_text: A citation position needs citation text. Type the citation, or set the position back to Default.
braille_fmt.err_total_rows: Total rows must be row numbers between 1 and the number of rows ({rows}), separated by commas.
braille_fmt.err_row_subheadings: Row subheadings: write one per line as "row number: text", with a row between 1 and {rows} and some text, each row once.
braille_fmt.err_guide_note: Own wording for the guide-dot note needs the note ticked. Tick it, or clear the wording.
braille_fmt.err_continued_text: Own wording for the continued note needs the continued note set to On.
braille_fmt.pagenum_button: Braille formatting for this print page change
braille_fmt.ignoreFont_help: Drops every font attribute (bold, italic, underline) from this block (BANA 2.9.1f and 5.3).
braille_fmt.diacriticNotation_help: Drops the font attribute of each run that carries a combining mark, a stress mark or a prime; other runs keep theirs (BANA 20.4.2).
braille_fmt.omitFullEmphasis_help: Drops font attributes when every text run of the block has the same emphasis; partial emphasis is kept (BANA 9.2.3b).
braille_fmt.omitEmphasis_help: Drops all font attributes from the block, where you judge they are not needed to tell things apart (BANA 14.3.1d).
braille_fmt.pageBreakBefore: Start on a new braille page
braille_fmt.pageBreakBefore_help: This block opens a fresh braille page; ignored when nothing precedes it (BANA 2.10.2b). Provisional: the print-page-number rule (2.10.2c) is a transcriber question.
braille_fmt.dedication_help: Groups this paragraph with the ones next to it that are also part of a dedication, judged together for decorative emphasis (BANA 2.9.1f).
braille_fmt.display_indent_help: The first line begins 2 cells right of the rest of the displayed passage, following print's own indent (BANA 9.2.2d). Off (blocked): the first line lines up with the rest of the passage. Only applies to a displayed quotation paragraph.
braille_fmt.diagram_help: Sets the paragraph in 1-3 margins, as a diagrammed sentence needs (BANA 18.7.1). BANA only.
braille_fmt.hangingMargins_help: Sets the paragraph in 1-3 margins instead of the usual paragraph margins. Provisional: taken from BANA example 3-2, not stated directly by rule 3.2.3.
braille_fmt.arrowLines_help: Your own arrow and shaft cells, one braille line per line here (BANA 18.8.1: a blank line goes before and after each arrow and sentence pair). A line wider than the page is cut to the page width.
braille_fmt.paraNumber_help: The paragraph must start with a line number. The number is written before the text at the paragraph's own indent and wraps with it (BANA 15.2.1b).
braille_fmt.songInfo_help: Items under a song title take 7-5 margins with no blank lines between them (BANA 13.11.2b). BANA only.
braille_fmt.lnNoteBeforeHeading_help: Set on the first line-numbered block: the automatic note goes before the heading just above it, with a blank line between (Sample 15-9). Default: after the heading.
braille_fmt.countedWords_help: Each line number follows the print line it counts, on the braille row where that line ends (BANA 15.8.1a).
braille_fmt.wordGaps_help: Every run of two or more spaces becomes a gap of two or three blank cells (BANA 19.4.1c).
braille_fmt.wideSpaces: Three blank cells for wide spaces
braille_fmt.wideSpaces_help: Each run of two or more spaces becomes three blank cells, for widely spaced words or phrases (BANA 13.6.3).
braille_fmt.rhymeLetters_help: A poem with a rhyme scheme and line numbers: the rhyme letter is written with the line and is not read as a line number (BANA 15.7.3d).
braille_fmt.uncontractedPoem_help: The whole poem is written uncontracted, with one grade 1 passage indicator before its first line and one terminator after its last (BANA 13.6.4a).
braille_fmt.displayedPoem_help: A poem centred in print is displayed material: two cells in from the poem margins (BANA 13.3.1c). BANA only.
braille_fmt.poemMethod_help: UKAAF B004 Appendix J only: write the poem continuously. Provisional: the transcriber questions on the indicator dots and where it goes are still open.
braille_fmt.keyList_help: A plain-text note whose first line introduces the list and whose further lines (two or more) are the items, at 1-3 margins between blank lines (BANA 3.3.2, Example 3-3).
braille_fmt.keyLocator: Dot locator in the key list
braille_fmt.keyLocator_help: Puts the dot locator before each symbol in the key list (BANA 2.5.2c). Use together with Key list.
braille_fmt.cell5_help: A short note that heads the list below it: 5-5 margins, a blank line before, the list directly under (BANA 10.9.2b). Provisional: the rule for a continuation note is a transcriber question.
braille_fmt.mentionSymbols_help: The print symbols this note mentions, separated by commas. The dot locator for mention goes before the first use of each in the note (BANA 2.5.2).
braille_fmt.after_note: Note explaining a symbol sits above
braille_fmt.after_note_help: The note that explains a symbol used in the list is placed directly above it (BANA 17.9.2a, Sample 17-11).
braille_fmt.word_list_help: Keeps the blank line after the directions (BANA 10.7.2b). Provisional: moving the list before the first question (10.7.2e) is a transcriber question.
braille_fmt.strip_continuation_help: On a contents list: a trailing continuation letter is dropped from each page number (BANA 2.10.7a).
braille_fmt.keep_emphasis_help: Keeps print emphasis (bold, italic…) even though the whole structure shares it — judged not decorative (BANA 8.1.4b, Example 8-6).
braille_fmt.translation_pairs_help: Displayed foreign text paired with its translation: formats the list as a nested list, no columns, and omits print emphasis that only distinguishes the two languages (BANA June 2024 9.2.6).
braille_fmt.item_ignore_font: Ignore font in the selected item(s)
braille_fmt.item_ignore_font_help: Print typeforms in the item with the caret, or every item selected, are ignored (BANA 2.9.1f).
braille_fmt.thesaurus_help: Sets the entries as a thesaurus (BANA 21.7.2).
braille_fmt.dictionary_help: Sets the entries as dictionary entries (BANA 21.7.3a and 21.8.5).
braille_fmt.alphabetic_margins_help: Main entries take the margins used for an alphabetic list (BANA 21.2.1b).
braille_fmt.shared_margin_help: The longest lead word already in an entry sits in cell 1 and the entry words line up after it (BANA 17.7.3).
braille_fmt.entry_word_help: The entry word is a cell-5 heading and the illustration under it follows with no blank line (BANA 21.6.5f).
braille_fmt.guideDots_help: On (the default): a short entry is filled with guide dots. Off: plain blank cells, for matching columns (BANA 10.9.1d).
braille_fmt.citationText_help: The source of the table, set at 5-5 margins (BANA 11.2.5g). Leave empty for none.
braille_fmt.citationPos_help: Default: after the bottom box line with a blank line after it. Inside the box: the last line inside the box (Sample 11-20).
braille_fmt.totalRows_help: Row numbers, counting from 1, separated by commas, for example 4, 9. A separation line goes above each total row (BANA 11.6.2b). Columnar layout only.
braille_fmt.rowSubheadings_help: One per line as "row number: text", for example 3: Vegetables. The subheading is written above that row (BANA 11.5.1b). Columnar layout only.
braille_fmt.guideDotNote_help: Adds the explanation of guide dots as the table's opening note when a blank entry occurs (UKAAF B004 12b). Columnar layout.
braille_fmt.guideDotNoteText: Own wording for the guide-dot note
braille_fmt.repeatHeadings: Repeat column headings on each page
braille_fmt.repeatHeadings_help: On repeats the column headings and separation line on each following braille page (BANA 11.4.4a). Columnar layout.
braille_fmt.continuedNote_help: On (BANA default) adds a "Table n (cont.)" note beside the page number (BANA 11.3.2b).
braille_fmt.continuedNoteText: Own wording for the continued note
braille_fmt.continuedNoteText_help: Needs the continued note set to On. Leave empty for the standard wording.
braille_fmt.dittoMarks_help: A cell holding only a ditto or quote mark is written as the plain repeat symbol instead of being translated (BANA 11.6.6).
braille_fmt.numericPassage_help: For a table whose row headings and column entries are all numbers: uses the numeric passage indicator instead of a numeral sign before every number, with a one-cell gap between columns where needed to keep the table on one page (BANA 11.7.1j-l). Columnar layout; ignored (with a warning) if the table is not all-numeric.
braille_fmt.key_help: One item per line, as "code: meaning" for a column-heading key or "row code: meaning" for a row-heading key, for example "nf: Number of employees" or "row aam: African American" (BANA 11.8.1-11.8.2).
braille_fmt.keyIntro_help: Your own wording for the key list’s opening line. Leave empty for the standard "Key to column headings:" / "Key to row headings:" / "Key to column and row headings:" (BANA 11.8.2a).
braille_fmt.err_table_key: Key of devised symbols: write one item per line, as "code: meaning" or "row code: meaning", with some meaning text.
braille_fmt.boxLines_help: On (the default): the sidebar has box lines. Off: a border-less sidebar (BANA 12.3.1e-g).
braille_fmt.boxColor_help: Names the box's colour (or "shaded"/"screened") at the start of the opening box line, in transcriber's-note brackets. Only printed when the document's boxes are not all the same colour (BANA 7.5.1-7.5.2).
braille_fmt.boxPageBreak: Start the box on a new braille page
braille_fmt.boxPageBreak_help: The whole sidebar opens a fresh braille page; ignored when nothing precedes it (BANA 2.10.2b).
braille_fmt.implied_help: The page number is implied, not printed (BANA 1.11.5).
braille_fmt.through_help: The last page of a combined, omitted or facing range: 25 with through 29 gives 25-29 (BANA 1.11.8 and 1.12.1).
braille_fmt.spelled_help: The print page number in words, when print spells it out as well as giving the number (BANA 1.13.1).
braille_fmt.combineWithNext_help: A blank or uncaptioned-picture print page is merged with the next print page that has text, with no indicator of its own (BANA 1.11.8d).
braille_fmt.unnumbered_help: A page change with no print number: a full-width row of dots 36 (BANA 1.11.6a).
braille_fmt.identifier: Insert an identifier before the caption
braille_fmt.identifier_help: When the table or image has no title or heading of its own, adds a word (Table, Figure, Chart …) before the caption, enclosed in transcriber's note indicators (BANA 11.2.8b).
braille_fmt.identifierText_help: Leave empty for the standard word (Illustration).
braille_fmt.doc_intro: Options for the whole document. They are saved in the document and come back when you open it again.
braille_fmt.doc_err_line_indicator: Line indicator: use one to three braille ASCII characters with no spaces, for example _.
braille_fmt.doc_verseKeep: Keep verse lines and stanzas together
braille_fmt.doc_verseKeep_help: On (the default in BANA): a verse line is never split across braille pages, and a stanza whose first line would end the page moves whole to the next (BANA 13.3.1b and 13.4.2).
braille_fmt.doc_listPageRules_help: On (the default in BANA): a list never starts on the last line of a page, and a multi-line first item never starts on the next-to-last (BANA 8.3.5b-c).
braille_fmt.doc_interpointOmitEven_help: BANA only: for interpoint braille, every even braille page loses its page number (BANA 1.15.1f).
braille_fmt.doc_endOfVolume_help: BANA, with volumes: "End of Volume n" on each volume's last page and "The End" after the last (BANA 1.6.5).
braille_fmt.doc_tocHeading_help: Your own wording for the generated contents page heading. Empty gives "Contents" (finding F-149).
braille_fmt.doc_tocRightBuffer_help: BANA: keeps the generated contents heading and every entry with no page number away from the right margin (BANA 2.10.7b).
braille_fmt.doc_lineIndicator_help: UKAAF poem line indicator, in braille ASCII. Empty gives the default underscore. Provisional: the dots (456 or 456-34) are a transcriber question (B004 Appendix J).
braille_fmt.doc_nestedBullets: Different bullets at each list level
braille_fmt.doc_nestedBullets_help: Uses a dot, a ring, then a small square for list levels 1, 2 and 3 (BANA 8.6.2 bullets).
braille_fmt.doc_endMarkers: End markers before every section heading
braille_fmt.doc_endMarkers_help: UKAAF only: a colons indicator line before every level-1 heading after the first, closing the section before it (B004 Glossary; James, UK-6). Off by default (UK-1) — turn on here for the whole document, or on one heading with its own "End marker before this heading" option.
braille_fmt.doc_tableEndMarker_help: UKAAF only: a dot-2s indicator line after each table (and its citation, if any) before text resumes (B004 Glossary; James, UK-6). On by default.
braille_fmt.doc_docEndMarker: End marker at the end of the document
braille_fmt.doc_docEndMarker_help: UKAAF only: a colons indicator line as the last line of the document — the last volume only, in a multi-volume book (B004 Glossary; James, UK-6). On by default.
braille_fmt.doc_showBullets_help: Off leaves unordered-list bullets out, showing the list by its layout instead (UKAAF convention; James, UK-10). Numbered and lettered items are unaffected. On by default.
braille_fmt.doc_runningHeadKeyWords_help: Your own key words for the running head, tried when the title does not fit (BANA 1.8.2e). You choose the words.
braille_fmt.doc_spacedEllipsis_help: Print typed as spaced periods (". . .") is written as the ellipsis symbol (UEB 7.3.1, Sample 15-4).
braille_fmt.doc_elisionApostrophe_help: A closing quote mark after a letter, as in comin', is written as an apostrophe (Sample 13-14).
braille_fmt.doc_typeformWordPunct_help: An emphasised word followed directly by punctuation needs no terminator (UEB 9.3.1 and 9.3.2, BANA Example 1-18).
braille_fmt.doc_pilPrintPage: Print page number on the page-information line
braille_fmt.doc_pilPrintPage_help: UKAAF: the print page number sits at cell 1 of the page information line, on every page (B004 7; James, UK-7). On by default; irrelevant in BANA.
braille_fmt.doc_exhaustiveSymbols_help: On: the Special Symbols page also lists the ordinary UEB symbols the document uses that BANA does not require listing — for example typeform, capitals and grade 1 indicators, the numeric indicator, the letter sign, accented-letter modifiers, and punctuation with a multi-cell braille form (BANA Appendix G).
braille_fmt.doc_foreignText_help: On: text marked as another language is brailled uncontracted, with the foreign alphabet signs for accented letters (French, German, Italian and Spanish from BANA Appendix D; Portuguese from World Braille Usage; other languages keep UEB accent signs) and UEB punctuation. Foreign words in a glossary are brailled this way even when this is off (BANA 21.6.3). If every numbered or lettered list is in the foreign language, the item letters have no grade 1 indicator (BANA 8.10). Off: foreign words are contracted, with UEB accent signs (BANA 1.16.2).
braille_fmt.doc_foreignTitle: The book title is in the foreign language (BANA 1.16.4)
braille_fmt.doc_foreignTitle_help: With "Foreign-language teaching text" on: the running head and the title on the first braille page are brailled as foreign material. The title page stays English.
braille_fmt.doc_guideWords: Guide words in glossaries and indexes
braille_fmt.doc_guideWords_help: On (the default in BANA): the last line of each braille page of a glossary, index, dictionary or other alphabetic reference longer than one page shows its first and last main entry words, joined by a dash, beside the braille page number (BANA 21.3.2). UKAAF has no guide words.
braille_fmt.doc_indexGuideWords_help: On (the default): indexes get guide words too. Turn off to omit them from indexes only, which BANA 21.3.2 allows an agency to do.
braille_fmt.transcriber_only: The formatting options for this block are transcriber tools. Turn on Transcriber tools in Settings to see them.

titlepage_details.menu_item_title: The book's title, authors, publisher, ISBN, transcriber and other Title Page facts (K29)
titlepage_details.title: Book details
titlepage_details.intro: Facts about this book and this transcription, for the Title Page. They are saved in the document and come back when you open it again. A field left empty is not brailled.
titlepage_details.title_help: The book's own title (also used for the running head and elsewhere in the document).
titlepage_details.gradeLevel_help: Only if clearly shown in print. A graphic grade level is given as an Arabic number.
titlepage_details.authors_help: One name per line, as printed. Leave empty if the book has no named author.
titlepage_details.editors_help: One name per line. Used on the title page only when there is no author (BANA 2.3.5f).
titlepage_details.publisherCity_help: The first city given in print, plus the state or province only if print gives one (BANA 2.3.6b).
titlepage_details.publisherUrl_help: Only if it is printed on the title page, copyright page or cover (BANA 2.3.6c).
titlepage_details.copyright_help: As printed, for example "Copyright © 2010 by Pearson". The copyright symbol, date and holder only — no rights-reservation statement (BANA 2.3.6d).
titlepage_details.reproductionNotice_warning_us: This wording is set by US law (2020 addendum, BANA 2.3.6e). Emboss lets you edit it, but changing it may make the notice legally incorrect.
titlepage_details.reproductionNotice_warning_uk: DRAFT wording, not yet confirmed by a UK producer — see docs/ukaaf-title-page-draft.md. Check it before using it in a real transcription.
titlepage_details.isbn_help: One per line. Leave empty to omit the "Transcription of ISBN" line (BANA 2.3.6f).
titlepage_details.isbn_from_source: From the document's own source ISBN ({isbn}). Edit or clear to use your own.
titlepage_details.err_year: Year transcribed: use a four-digit year, for example 2026.

table.title: Table ({cols} cols × {rows} rows)
table.fmt_auto_title: Auto: columns when they fit, otherwise vertical division, facing pages or listed (BANA) / paragraph form (UKAAF). Click for Spatial
table.fmt_listed_title: Listed table. Click for Vertical Division
table.fmt_vertical_title: Vertical Division (BANA §11.14): columns split into sections, row headings repeated. Click for Facing Pages
table.fmt_facing_title: Facing Pages (BANA §11.13): the table is read across a left-hand and a right-hand page. Click for Interchanged
table.fmt_interchange_title: Interchanged Columns and Rows (BANA §11.15): the print columns become rows and the rows columns, when that fits the page. Click for Stairstep
table.fmt_stairstep_title: Stairstep (BANA §11.18): each entry on its own line, indented by column. Click for Linear
table.fmt_linear_title: Linear (BANA §11.17): each row as one line, entries separated by semicolons. Click for Auto
table.too_wide_listed: Too wide for columns — brailled as a listed table
table.too_wide_listed_title: This table does not fit in columns at the current cells-per-line and braille mode, so it will be brailled as a listed table (BANA Formats §11.9) instead of side-by-side columns.
table.too_wide_paragraph: Too wide for columns — brailled in paragraph form
table.too_wide_paragraph_title: This table does not fit in columns at the current cells-per-line and braille mode, so it will be brailled in paragraph form (UKAAF B004 §12) instead of side-by-side columns.
